sections.reference_ayurved_sar_sangrah_17th_editi: Sukha Virechana Vati is an Ayurvedic medicine in herbal tablet form. It is used in the treatment of constipation. This medicine is also used in Virechana (Purgation) therapy, which is done to balance the pitta dosha.
sections.ingredients:
Jamalgota – Croton tiglium – 13g 
 Shunti – Ginger Rhizome – Zingiber officinalis – powder – 24 g 
 Water – Quantity sufficient for grinding. 

 Method of Preparation 
 Jamalgota (Croton tiglium) seeds are broken into two parts. These seeds are dipped in the boiling water by covering it completely for whole night. In the morning proper washing and grinding is done. After the complete grinding, add the 24 gram powder of Shunti (Zingiber officinalis). This mixture is minced with water for 8 hours to make the tablets. Tablets are dried and stored. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Sukha virechana vati is an efficient Ayurvedic formulation that helps to keep the Pitta and Vata doshas in balanced condition. It has laxative property. As per Ayurveda, Ama or undigested food is considered as a root cause for all the diseases including digestive and other such as rheumatoid arthritis. If body metabolism is proper, one can avoid plenty of diseases to happen. This herbal remedy can be taken on regular basis to have proper motion without efforts in all such conditions including anal fistula, piles and fissures. Well indicated in chronic constipation as well.

Sukha Virechana Vati 
 Reference: Ayurved Sar Sangrah 17th edition, page no 448. 
 Sukha Virechana Vati is an Ayurvedic medicine in herbal tablet form. It is used in the treatment of constipation. This medicine is also used in Virechana (Purgation) therapy, which is done to balance the pitta dosha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Jamalgota – Croton tiglium – 13g 
 Shunti – Ginger Rhizome – Zingiber officinalis – powder – 24 g 
 Water – Quantity sufficient for grinding. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Jamalgota (Croton tiglium) seeds are broken into two parts. These seeds are dipped in the boiling water by covering it completely for whole night. In the morning proper washing and grinding is done. After the complete grinding, add the 24 gram powder of Shunti (Zingiber officinalis). This mixture is minced with water for 8 hours to make the tablets. Tablets are dried and stored. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Sukha virechana vati is an efficient Ayurvedic formulation that helps to keep the Pitta and Vata doshas in balanced condition. It has laxative property. As per Ayurveda, Ama or undigested food is considered as a root cause for all the diseases including digestive and other such as rheumatoid arthritis. If body metabolism is proper, one can avoid plenty of diseases to happen. This herbal remedy can be taken on regular basis to have proper motion without efforts in all such conditions including anal fistula, piles and fissures. Well indicated in chronic constipation as well. 
 Indications 
 It helps to relieve constipation. 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet of 250 mg at bed time as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Side Effects 
 Over dosage may cause heart burn and diarrhea. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
